hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a volatility-adjusted fee on every swap, with the rate scaling linearly from a base fee to a maximum based on how far the previous swap moved the tick price. Fees are taken in the pool's quote currency as ERC-6909 claims and forwarded to an immutable fee wallet via a permissionless sweep().
